proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove all five in manual order. Use left branch of disjunctive VCs. Initialize the shifted prefix, unfold one suffix node using guard, append that node with local shift lemma and physical 32-bit capacity bound, then rule out nonempty final suffix using duplicate header.prev ownership and reconstruct store_dll. Finish nil specialization via wand introduction. Only suffixed proved case_lib helpers may be added.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: All five obligations preserve shared DLL node data and arbitrary storeA. Overflow is derived from owned field capacity, while sentinel exclusion is derived only where the VC owns the conflicting sentinel field.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All five belong to DoubleLinkListLenGet and the same shifted-prefix/list-ownership proof family. Count 5 is below max 12. One worker can reuse local capacity/closing helpers without cross-group dependencies.
